definitions.name: L3C.ENC
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'C' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 2 -1 -2 ] RECORD C GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Bracket String -> Vector of codes: open ( 1, open [ 2, close ) -1, close ] -2.

definitions.name: L3C.FIN
definitions.body: L3C.ENC [ 0 ] [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 DROP A E 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 E 0 LT A -1 TAKE 0 GET E ADD 0 EQ AND SELECT GET ] FOLD
definitions.note: Bracket String -> final cancellation stack with a leading 0 sentinel; its length minus 1 is the unmatched count.

definitions.name: L3C.ST
definitions.body: L3C.ENC [ 0 ] [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 DROP A E 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 E 0 LT A -1 TAKE 0 GET E ADD 0 EQ AND SELECT GET ] SCAN
definitions.note: Bracket String -> the cancellation stack after each prefix (one lane per character).

definitions.name: L3C.ABS
definitions.note: Number or Vector -> absolute value, as max of x and minus x.

definitions.name: L3C.MED
definitions.body: 'MX' BIND MX SORT 'MS' BIND MS MX LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR MX LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET L2B.MEAN
definitions.note: Non-empty numeric Vector -> median (mean of the two middle values when even).

definitions.name: L3C.STARTS
definitions.body: 'SX' BIND SX 1 DROP SX -1 DROP SUB [ 0 EQ NOT ] MAP 'SD' BIND TRUE 1 COLLECT SD CONCAT L1D.WHERE
definitions.note: Non-empty Vector -> indices where a run of equal adjacent values starts.

definitions.name: L3C.RLE
definitions.body: 'RX' BIND RX L3C.STARTS 'RS' BIND RS 1 DROP RX LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT RS SUB 'RC' BIND RX RS GET RC 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Non-empty Vector -> run-length pairs [ value count ].

definitions.name: L3C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'BN' BIND BN [ 0 GET ] MAP BN [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'BG' BIND BG KEYS BG VALUES [ L2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries -> Record from name to summed amount, names in first-appearance order.

definitions.name: L3C.ARGMAX
definitions.body: 'AR' BIND AR KEYS 'AK' BIND AR VALUES 'AS' BIND AS G0C.MAXV 'AM' BIND AK AS [ AM EQ ] MAP L1D.WHERE 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record of numbers -> the key with the largest value, the first such key on ties.

definitions.name: L3C.CAP
definitions.body: 'CW' BIND CW CHARS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER CW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Non-empty word -> first letter upper case, the rest kept as they are.

definitions.name: L3C.SJ
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS -1 DROP JOIN
definitions.note: Non-empty Vector of texts -> one text with single spaces between them.
